name: Claude
tagline: Frontier reasoning intelligence model excelling at complex logic, deep coding, and nuanced prose.
description: Anthropic's flagship family of models (Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku) offering instant responses, extended thinking tokens, and industry-leading developer and coding capabilities.
pricingDetails: Free tier with daily quota. Claude Pro is $20/month for 5x capacity, extended thinking controls, and priority access.
bestFor: Developers, researchers, and writers who need deep analytical reasoning and honest, nuanced output.
keyFeatures: Hybrid reasoning toggle: switch between instant latency and deep chain-of-thought
200K token context window supporting large codebases and multi-chapter manuscripts
Claude Artifacts side-by-side interactive playground for React, SVG, and HTML
Claude Projects: persistent document repositories and instructions
pros: Industry-leading human-like prose without formulaic structures
Exceptional algorithmic and architecture refactoring capabilities
cons: Daily limits on the free tier during peak hours
No native search engine indexing on the free web interface

faqs.question: What is hybrid reasoning in Claude 3.7?
faqs.answer: Hybrid reasoning allows users to toggle an extended thinking budget, giving Claude time to test multiple hypotheses before generating its final answer.
